name: Hill-type static controller on gene expression (control, the source's comparison)
question: Does the output return to its set point after a step of the input, and through which variable?

provenance.source: Briat, Gupta and Khammash, Cell Systems 2, 15 (2016), doi:10.1016/j.cels.2016.01.004 (arXiv:1410.6064v7): reactions (1) and (10) with mass action; parameters of Fig. 3

assumptions: deterministic mass-action equations of the reactions (the source studies the stochastic model and prints the deterministic one for k2 = theta = gamma1 = gamma2 = 1)
the step of the source: k2 from 3 to 6 (Fig. 3)

regulation.change: the antithetic pair replaced by the static controller f(x2) = alpha K^n/(K^n + x2^n) of Eq. (12), n = 1, alpha = 8.22, K = 3 (Fig. 3)
